feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 16 November 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Monday, 16 November 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Clear spells with a few showers at first today as well as a slight frost and a risk of icy patches in places. It will then be dry with sunny spells for the rest of the morning, turning cloudy through the afternoon, with rain arriving later in the evening, turning wintry on high ground.

Moderate northwest winds become light and variable for a time during the day, before settling easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong to gale force later in evening. Top temperature of 8°C.

Rain through the night into Tuesday, turning heavy at times, and initially wintry on higher ground.

Rain persisting for much of the day, before slowly clearing later. Strong to gale force easterly winds easing slightly. Top temperature 10°C.


##Outlook##

Generally cloudy with outbreaks of rain at times. Moderate to fresh northeast winds strengthening later. Top temperature 9°C.

7:49am Tomorrow
